response.evidence: Source diff inspection and test logs confirm: 1) WriteJournal.archive() atomically removes active journal state ('version', 'uid', 'payload') via SharedPreferences edit.commit() while appending timestamped 'archive_$slot' records, which NfcCoordinator.archivedWrites() exposes and NfcPanel renders in a scrollable UI list without automated eviction; 2) CatalogEntry.asCatalogItem() evaluates field values via item.values() and assigns empty source strings to blank fields rather than claiming 'OFD $sourceRevision' provenance; 3) hydrateLegacyRecent() resolves legacy recent snapshots against local custom_records via UserDao.byId() before falling back to catalog_entries; 4) OpenSpoolCodec enforces the 4 additional colors limit specifically during PAXX encoding, allowing validateRecord() and canonical encoding to handle records with >4 additional colors vendor-neutrally; 5) DeviceCatalogAcceptanceTest on motorola razr 2023 verifies 22,347 catalog entries with warm query p95 latencies between 5.08ms and 20.46ms (well within the <100ms target); 6) All unit and core test suites pass without errors (6 StorageAcceptanceTest, 12 OpenSpoolCodecTest, 10 WriteStateMachineTest).
